{{Quote|I never thought I'd find true love on Zeltros, and I didn't. What I did find was a double-jointed Zeltron cafarel named Lissahl who taught me the errors of monogamy. I might never leave!|Jiri Sools|<ref name="ZPP">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040105zeltros|text=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet|int=Zeltros: Pleasure Planet}}</ref>}}
'''Lissahl''' was a double-jointed<ref name="ZPP" /> [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] working as a [[Cafarel|carafel]]<ref name="CSWE" />&mdash;high demand [[Prostitute/Legends|courtesans]] that fulfilled physical desires<ref name="SWG1">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>&mdash;on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zeltros/Legends|Zeltros]]. Before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="CSWE" /> between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Clone Wars">{{CSWECite|I|131|Clone Wars}}</ref> broke out in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> she befriended the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Jiri Sools]], who fell madly in love with her.<ref name="CSWE" />

Sools was so infatuated with Lissahl that he vowed to never leave Zeltros again.<ref name="CSWE" /> He provided his testimonial to a travel advisory where he said that though he did not find his true love, Lissahl had shown him what he saw as errors of monogamy.<ref name="ZPP" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lissahl was first mentioned in the first part of "[[Zeltros: Pleasure Planet]]," an article compiled by [[Cory J. Herndon]] and published on [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s website on [[January 5]], [[2004]].<ref name="ZPP" />
